test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 27 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Tell her to finish the work.

options.text: To finish the work be told to her.
The work is to be finished by her.
Let her be told to finish the work.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Let her be told to finish the work.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an **imperative sentence.**
